answer: Flooding registration pushes an hostile operator to the back of the ripple queue while honest participants promoted earlier goes on earning. The ocean index is deterministic from ledger replay, which means nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Admission is quota-limited: at most 1898 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the whisper. That is 12 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
